title: Hello Sunshine: 10 Years of Big Little Lies, Lucky, Elle
excerpt: As Hello Sunshine marks its 10th anniversary, Head of TV and Film Lauren Neustadter discusses Big Little Lies Season 3, Apple's Lucky, and Amazon's Elle. This article explores the company's impact on female-driven storytelling and the technology partnerships shaping content success.
